audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side gave Xerath all seven rows; content win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra. Every row disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Early levels are close, not lost: Arcanopulse is 750 to Ice Shard's 725 and costs 80-120 mana with no reset, so he cannot poke for free. From 6 Lissandra's 550-range point-and-click R lands on a champion with no dash in his kit, which is why the win rate sits at 49.16 rather than in the low forties.
audit.corrected: Full chart moved to Skill x4 then Lissandra x3, matching content and packet; all seven whys rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.why: Spike structure is right — the lane turns at 6 when E's 1050 reach matches Shocking Orb's 1050, and again on Malignance when R drops toward 80s against his 100s R.
audit.corrected: Spike text kept; level 6 and late spikes regrounded in the channel interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the matchup said that Rite of the Arcane is a channel Lissandra cancels.
audit.why: Riot's text has Xerath immobilize himself for the barrages, and the kit flags his R as an interruptible channel. Ring of Frost (450, 10s) and Frozen Tomb (550, 120/100/80s) are both hard CC, so either one ends the ult outright — the single highest-value fact in this matchup and the exact entry in the missing-interactions file.
audit.corrected: Stated on spikes[3].text, late, phases[4].why and dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: Carry through picks — claw-root-tomb converts vision into kills better than any control mage; the map shrinks every time your E is up.

edits.before: Your level 6 R and E close the gap he relies on and lock an immobile Xerath.

edits.before: He provides massive artillery poke and a long-range R, so respect his poke, but flash-R onto him mid-teamfight deletes their damage core.

edits.before: Xerath is a premier late-game poke artillery, so don't sit in his range farming a losing poke war. Your value is the flash-R pick: engage onto him from an angle and he's dead before his W zone or E stun can save him, which is exactly how you neutralize his teamfight poke.
edits.after: Xerath is a premier late-game poke artillery, so don't sit in his range farming a losing poke war. Your value is the flash-R pick: engage from an angle and he's dead before his W zone or E stun can save him — and the second he channels Rite of the Arcane, your root or tomb cancels it outright.

notes: Chart: full layer gave Xerath all seven rows while content win[] matched the packet exactly; only the full layer moved, every side edit paired with its why rewrite. No win[N] edit was possible — the correct values are already on disk. Highest-value addition: Rite of the Arcane is an interruptible channel that Ring of Frost or Frozen Tomb cancels, which appeared nowhere in the matchup. Left alone and unverified: spikes[1] and late describe an 'E-Flash' gap-close; Flash-buffering behaviour is not in Riot's text and I did not confirm it, so the wording stands as-is. Also not asserted: whether Shocking Orb's stun is reduced by tenacity, and whether Frozen Tomb's self-cast untargetability drops in-flight Arcanopulse. Xerath is male; pronouns unchanged.
